logic:
- Each tap is worth the post's **points per tap**, so a modded post can be worth more per bounce

description:
## What's This? 🏐

A ball on the grass, in 3D. Tap it, it bounces, you score. Keep hitting it in mid-air to build a rally, before the 30 second clock runs out.

## Scoring ⭐

- Every tap is worth the post's **points per tap** (10 by default)
- Consecutive mid-air hits build a **rally** — let the ball land and it starts over 🔄
- Your longest rally is what shows up next to your score 🏆

## Tips 💡

- The ball hangs for a moment at the top of its arc — that is the easy hit 🎯
- Hitting it off-centre pushes it sideways, so you can steer it back to the middle ↔️
- A gentle rhythm beats frantic tapping; let it come to you 🥁
